description: Use when an agent plans ahead and needs every closure of a stock exchange for a whole year: holiday names, half days, late openings, regular hours, count of trading days. 28 exchanges incl. NYSE, Nasdaq, LSE, Xetra, Euronext, SIX, Tokyo, HKEX, Shanghai, ASX. Official exchange calendars only; bad input or uncovered year: HTTP 400, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

exchange.description: Exchange MIC code, e.g. XNYS (NYSE), XNAS (Nasdaq), XLON (London), XETR (Xetra), XPAR (Paris), XTKS (Tokyo), XHKG (Hong Kong). Common names also work (NYSE, Xetra, LSE). Free list: GET /v1/exchanges.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2026. Optional, default: current year.

name: trading_calendar
title: Exchange Trading Calendar
